name: Linklet Telegram Support Bot
summary: A Telegram support assistant for Linklet that answers common marketplace questions in the user's language and points people to the right next step.
problem: A small marketplace needs a support presence without a staffed help desk. The same questions about posting, payments, and account safety arrive repeatedly, sometimes in different languages.
solution: A Node.js Telegram bot keeps a short per-chat history and sends it to a Groq-hosted model with a Linklet-specific system prompt. It answers in the language the person uses, keeps responses short, and directs uncertain cases to the website or the team. A small HTTP server keeps the service alive on a free host.
